integrity: Two exhaustive prefix engines agree on every candidate through length \(22\), and two independent circular-critical-exponent scans agree on all \(3042\) threshold candidates. The equality set and symmetry orbit are recomputed from the definitions.
scientific_limitations: The result is specific to ternary circular words of length \(22\). It does not determine the minimum circular critical exponent for other lengths or change the asymptotic threshold. An unpublished computation or unindexed table could contain the same finite value.
title: Exact circular critical exponent at ternary length \(22\)
